definitions.caught: NOTE or WATCH from decide_with_unknowns() at any evaluation point, i.e. by the campaign's last move
definitions.lead_time_days: days from the first evaluation point whose decision is NOTE or WATCH to the final action; the final action is the Bypass release if the campaign has one, else its last move; undefined for a missed campaign
definitions.forget_W: a copy of the template with every event older than T - W days removed, no Normal node, no visibility edge or Place, no remembered first-seen time (redteam/score.py forget); the detectors then run unchanged as of T
definitions.patience_days: days from the attacker's first action to the privilege grant
definitions.false_flag_rate: flagged / n on clean campaigns: NOTE or WATCH at any point of a benign campaign (a new contributor granted at a normal pace, then a release on the normal path)
definitions.delta: arm minus full, on the same campaigns
definitions.verdict: better / tied / worse is stated per patience level from the paired counts, with no rounding and no significance claim; n per level is small
